name: fmp_market_hours
description:
Trading hours and open/closed status of stock exchanges from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/market-hours as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
For exchange names use fmp_available_exchanges.
Example: {}
